description: This Java source file implements the '<continue>' element for the MiniLang scripting language used in the OFBiz framework. It defines a class 'Continue' that, when executed, throws an exception to signal a continue operation within a loop, along with a nested exception class and a factory class for creating instances of 'Continue'.

classes.name: Continue
classes.description: Represents the '<continue>' XML element in the mini-language. When executed, it throws a 'ContinueElementException' to signal a loop continuation.

classes.name: Continue.ContinueElementException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown during the execution of a '<continue>' element to indicate a continue operation inside a loop, with detailed message information.

classes.name: Continue.ContinueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the 'Continue' operation from XML elements.

methods.name: Continue(Element, SimpleMethod)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Continue operation with XML element and method context.

methods.name: exec(MethodContext)
methods.description: Executes the continue operation by throwing a ContinueElementException.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the '<continue/>' element.

methods.name: ContinueElementException()
methods.description: Constructor creating an exception indicating the '<continue>' element was encountered outside of a loop.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Provides a detailed message about the exception, including file, method, element, and line number.

methods.name: createMethodOperation(Element, SimpleMethod)
methods.description: Factory method creating a new instance of Continue.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the name of the element this factory creates, which is 'continue'.
